events.name: Christmas Express
events.venue_name_text: Kettle Valley Steam Railway, Prairie Valley Station
events.description: A one-hour holiday ride on the Kettle Valley Steam Railway, with Christmas lights aboard the 3716 locomotive, music, carols, a hot drink and Santa. Departures at 4:30 and 6:30 pm on select December dates. Tickets are non-refundable; book ahead.

events.name: Freya & Friends: Okanagan Symphony Holiday Concert
events.description: The Okanagan Symphony Orchestra’s holiday concert with the folk duo Freya, Okanagan composer, pianist and vocalist Leila Naderi, and the Okanagan Symphony Chorus, mixing new songs with reimagined favourites. About two hours, with a pre-concert chat one hour before. Tickets $18–$75.

events.name: Freya & Friends: Okanagan Symphony Holiday Concert
events.description: The Okanagan Symphony Orchestra’s holiday concert with the folk duo Freya, Okanagan composer, pianist and vocalist Leila Naderi, and the Okanagan Symphony Chorus, mixing new songs with reimagined favourites. About two hours, with a pre-concert chat one hour before. Tickets $18–$75.

events.name: The Nutcracker: Mission Dance Company
events.description: Mission Dance Company, with guest dancers from Okanagan Ballet Theatre, performs a family-friendly, two-hour Nutcracker with live narration. There’s also a silent auction and a post-show reception with the cast. Shows at 2 pm and 7 pm; tickets $20–$54.

events.name: Festival of Trees at Mission Hill
events.description: Holiday trees decorated by sponsors are on display at Mission Hill for the season. The Festival of Trees Tasting Experience ($65) walks past the trees and finishes with a seated wine flight, with part of each ticket going to BC Children’s Hospital Foundation. Estate access is by reservation.

occurrences.label: Trees on display Nov 20 – Jan 3; tasting experience Nov 21 – Dec 31

events.name: Magic on Main Street: Santa Claus Parade & Light Up
events.description: Penticton’s Santa Claus Parade travels down Main Street to Gyro Park for the official downtown light-up, with Santa, a 180-foot light tunnel and a giant “light brite”. Free, with a free Park, Shop ’n’ Ride shuttle from Cherry Lane.

occurrences.label: Parade 4:30 pm; light-up 6 pm in Gyro Park

events.name: West Kelowna Winterfest
events.description: A free family winter weekend at the Mount Boucherie Community Centre arena and courtyard, including storytime with Santa and skating with Santa. The city posts the full schedule on November 20.

events.name: Christmas Sleigh Rides at Ottercrest Farms
events.description: Horse-drawn Christmas sleigh rides at Ottercrest Farms on select December afternoons, with rides every half hour. Tickets $31 adults, $20 children 4–12; children 3 and under ride free.

events.name: Stars on Ice Holiday Tour
events.description: A holiday edition of Stars on Ice, with Olympic, World and National champion figure skaters performing holiday-themed programs. Tickets $35–$110.

events.name: A 1940s Radio Christmas Carol
events.description: A comedy in which a WWII-era troupe performs a live radio broadcast of A Christmas Carol, complete with vintage carols, mock commercials and backstage mishaps. Tickets $41.25 adults, $20.75 students.

events.name: Oh Come All Ye Soulful
events.description: A holiday concert by vocalist Dawn Pemberton and bassist Jodi Proznick with an all-star band, playing soul and jazz holiday classics in the spirit of Ray Charles, Stevie Wonder and Ella Fitzgerald. All seats $49.

events.name: Yuletide @ the PTCC
events.description: A three-day holiday market with local artisans, gift vendors and specialty food sellers, plus the kids-only Little Elf Shop. Admission $3 a day.

events.name: Christmas at the Laurel
events.description: A three-day, European-style holiday market in the historic Laurel Packinghouse, with handmade gifts from local artisans and festive treats. Admission by donation to the Food Bank.

events.name: It's Christmas @ the Red Barn
events.description: A two-day holiday market with more than 50 local makers selling clothing, gourmet foods, body products, jewelry and home decor. Free admission; Food Bank donations welcome.

events.name: Christkindl Holiday Market
events.description: A traditional European-style Christmas market in the Laurel Packinghouse, with handmade local gifts, festive treats and hot cider. Admission by donation to the Food Bank.

events.name: The Last Chance Holiday Market
events.description: A two-day market of handmade gifts from local artisans, specialty foods and festive treats, billed as the last local shopping stop before Christmas. Admission $3 at the door.

updates.name: TELUS Kelowna Cup at Big White

fields.description: A family-friendly snowcross race on the Snow Cross Track at Big White's TELUS Park, open to skiers and snowboarders of all skill levels. Racers try to match their first-run time on a second run, and the closest match wins the grand prize; there's a Best Dressed prize too. The event supports the Powderhounds, the adaptive snowsports program of People in Motion. Big White says full details are coming soon, so check before you go.
